body:
[Chief] J1202 HOS back-post, 29 Oct (London). Ben OK: "Yes, back-post all five older HOS Shorts"

I checked each file against its upload record, did a dry run, then scheduled through the standard `mirrorVideo` path (duplicate and org guards on, media on R2). Each post goes to Instagram, Facebook and TikTok via the HOS Buffer org. TikTok only goes through Buffer.

Scheduled, one Short per slot, spaced around the 4 already queued:
- Brand "He boiled urine for gold…" (oKqmnJNGiHg; checksum matches the registered upload): Thu 29 Oct 15:00 London.
- Curved flask "Pasteur's curved glass flask…" (-3L6HzJ_d_4; checksum matches the registry and the QA inventory): Sun 2 Nov 11:30 London.

Held, because the checksum doesn't match:
- Herschel c2q7w0pgcn8 and Snow OnJ8MFu0Mi0: they were uploaded on 15 Oct from files with sha256 af0b78f6… and 1bd61d35…. Both local files were re-rendered in place on 17 Oct 06:02–06:03, and their manifests were rewritten at 06:07 to the new hashes (e00f20b3…, 634abd5e…). No copy of the uploaded files is left on the mini, so I can't show the Buffer copy would match what's live.
- Cathode rays LCZRHUyTiq0: the registered file `02_Video-Projects/004_…/10_Shorts/hos_004_s04_cathode_rays_v01.mp4` (5a7b3c42…) is missing. The iCloud HOS UAT copy with the same name is 027dc6f1…, so it doesn't match either.
- To post these three, either restore the uploaded files, or have Ben OK posting the 17 Oct renders or the iCloud copy as they are.

Cap: Buffer now holds 6 scheduled posts per channel (Instagram 6, Facebook 6, TikTok 6), under the free plan's 10. The daily check adds xHnIi9GqOsM and PFj6172YU4Q as they come within 7 days.
Not touched: the failed Curie AMSriTQ-lcQ Facebook post. Dropped: nothing.
Record: OWB c3c0261ab (`social/hos/BUFFER_POSTS.json` and `UPLOADS.json`).

[Chief] J1202 HOS back-post, last three, Thu 29 Oct (London). Ben OK: "Yes, post the 17 Oct re-renders and the iCloud cathode rays copy"

These go out from the files below. Each one differs from the YouTube upload, as Ben approved on 29 Oct. I checked each file's sha256, did a dry run, then scheduled through the standard `mirrorVideo` path (duplicate and org guards on, media on R2). Each post goes to Instagram, Facebook and TikTok via the HOS Buffer org. TikTok only goes through Buffer.

- **Wed 4 Nov 11:30:** Herschel "Who Discovered Infrared Light?" (c2q7w0pgcn8). Source: the 17 Oct re-render `docs/STANDALONE_SHORTS_TEST_2026-10/shorts_v01/hos_sa_s1_herschel_infrared_v01.mp4`, sha256 e00f20b39383da19… (the upload was af0b78f6…).
- **Fri 6 Nov 11:30:** "What Are Cathode Rays?" (LCZRHUyTiq0). Source: the iCloud HOS UAT copy `004_Whats-Really-Inside-An-Atom/10_Shorts/hos_004_s04_cathode_rays_v01.mp4`, sha256 027dc6f11efaa008… (the upload was 5a7b3c42…).
- **Sat 7 Nov 11:30:** Snow "How Did John Snow Stop Cholera?" (OnJ8MFu0Mi0). Source: the 17 Oct re-render `…/hos_sa_s3_snow_pump_v02.mp4`, sha256 634abd5ef8a0d031… (the upload was 1bd61d35…).

I skipped Thu 5 Nov (veins) because that day already has an HOS post. Each source sha256, the upload sha256 and Ben's approval are recorded in `social/hos/UPLOADS.json` and `BUFFER_POSTS.json` (OWB 1405b8a52).

Cap: Buffer now holds 9 scheduled posts per channel (Instagram 9, Facebook 9, TikTok 9), one HOS Short per day from Thu 29 Oct to Sat 7 Nov except Thu 5 Nov. Every create succeeded. The daily check adds veins (Thu 5 Nov) and the tight band Short (Sun 8 Nov) as posts go out, which keeps each channel at 10 or fewer.

J1203 (download the live cuts from Studio) is cancelled as superseded, so these three can't be posted twice (OWB 56525b839).
Not touched: the failed Curie Facebook post. Dropped: nothing.
